title: BetterTogether Profiling Range Record
description: One measurement of a contiguous stage range [start_stage, end_stage] dispatched as ONE GPU chunk, through the path a pipeline's GPU chunk uses (its submissions, host cache maintenance and any host read-back between stages), after a stated idle gap. Stored as JSON Lines in range-NNN.jsonl next to the per-stage run-NNN.jsonl of the same (device, app, backend, scenario) directory; readers of run-*.jsonl never see these records. Emitted by bm-ranges-<app>-vk; read by optimizer/smt/profiling_loader.load_ranges.

schema.description: Format tag of range records; distinct from the per-stage 'bt.profiling/v0'.

device.description: Device id, matching a devices/<id>.json stem (e.g. 'minipc', '3A021JEHN02756').

backend.description: GPU backend the binary was built for.

scenario.description: 'isolated' = the GPU runs the range alone. 'interference' = every present CPU tier runs the range's stages in a busy loop meanwhile (bm-prof's background load).

run.description: Run number. Also encoded in the filename (run-NNN.jsonl); duplicated here so a record is self-contained once detached from its file.

start_stage.description: First stage of the range (1-based, inclusive).

end_stage.description: Last stage of the range (1-based, inclusive, >= start_stage).

pu.description: The GPU processing unit that ran the range.

gap_ms.description: Idle time before every measured chunk, in milliseconds: 0 = back-to-back; otherwise the host slept this long before each chunk (design D3: the range's own back-to-back p50).

submissions.description: Queue submissions one chunk of this range takes (e.g. 2 for a tree range crossing stage 3|4, which reads n_unique back on the host in between).

timing.description: Whole-chunk host wall time per chunk (dispatch_wall: submit to completion, every submission and read-back included), not GPU timestamps.

cv.description: Coefficient of variation (stddev/mean); the noise gate the loader filters on.

provenance.description: As for per-stage records, plus the GPU clock sampled while the range ran.

git_sha.description: Short git sha of the binary, stamped at build time. 'unknown' if built outside a git tree.

ts.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of the run.

freq_governor.description: cpu0 scaling_governor read from /sys at runtime; 'unknown' where unreadable.

freq_locked.description: Derived: governor is 'performance' or 'userspace' (DVFS effectively pinned).

gpu_clock_mhz.description: Median of the positive GPU clock samples taken while the range was measured (MHz); -1 if the device exposes no readable clock or never read busy.

gpu_clock_samples.description: Number of positive clock samples behind gpu_clock_mhz.

gpu_clock_min_mhz.description: Lowest positive clock sample (MHz), -1 if none.

gpu_clock_max_mhz.description: Highest positive clock sample (MHz), -1 if none.
